desc: A grounded answer citing a given entry is kept
An answer citing an entry we did not send becomes a handoff
An answer with no citation becomes a handoff
Text that is not JSON becomes a handoff
The prompt holds only the question and the approved entries
Without a key the server reports the model as unavailable
Without a key /api/chat refuses (503) and calls nothing
With a key the server reports the model, never the key
/api/chat returns the checked answer and the model name
The served page is the built app
